opening.argument: The offer promises a $500 Walmart gift card now, then tells viewers to click Continue and submit an email ID to get it. The title and description repeat the reward claim, and the description directs viewers to a shortened URL. That combination presents the gift card as an immediate, low-effort reward while moving viewers through a click and email-submission step. The available evidence does not establish Walmart authorization, delivery, fees, or what awaits after the click; those limits do not change the observable pitch or the action it asks viewers to take.
